channel.title: GLab articles
channel.description: GLab is where Guang shares practical projects, technical guides, and lessons from networking, cybersecurity, AI, hands-on engineering, community technology, and sustainable farming.

item.title: Building with Nature in Mind: A Practical Technology Checklist
item.description: A practical checklist for choosing tools that fit local needs, use data responsibly, remain maintainable, and take environmental effects seriously—without treating every new device as progress.

item.title: How to Choose a Laptop for Real Work in 2026
item.description: A workload-first laptop buying guide for trading, multitasking, development, Linux, virtual machines, cybersecurity labs, and networking—covering performance, thermals, battery, upgradeability, and value in India.

item.title: The Greenest Upgrade May Be the One You Do Not Buy
item.description: A decision guide for diagnosing slow electronics, protecting data, checking repairability, extending useful life, and choosing responsible reuse or recycling in India.

item.title: Passkeys, Recovery, and the Human Side of Security
item.description: A practical guide to phishing-resistant sign-in, account recovery, backup methods, and the habits that keep a stronger login system usable.

item.title: How I Decide Whether a Task Needs AI
item.description: A practical decision framework for choosing between AI, ordinary software, web research, and a person—with verification, privacy, and error cost built in.

item.title: Better Light Begins by Protecting the Dark
item.description: A practical outdoor-lighting checklist: aim light where it is needed, use no more than necessary, choose warm light where suitable, add controls, and inspect spill after dark.

item.title: A Soil Sensor Is a Question, Not an Answer
item.description: A field-ready framework for placing moisture sensors, checking readings against soil and crop conditions, keeping an irrigation log, and avoiding false precision.

item.title: What Soil Can Teach Us About Measurement
item.description: A short reflection on uncertainty, context, and why measurement tools should support local knowledge instead of pretending one number tells the whole story.

item.title: Before I Build With AI, I Ask Who Carries the Risk
item.description: A practical AI review checklist covering intended users, error costs, privacy, transparency, human override, and ways to challenge or correct outputs.

item.title: Security Is a Form of Care
item.description: A practical, human-centred security guide to reducing risk, respecting consent, protecting identity, limiting privileged access, responding to incidents, and making safer behaviour easier.
